# Source Hub India

> Trusted legal document partner for Fortune 500 companies. 20+ years of litigation support, document management, and legal coding services.

Source Hub India Pvt Ltd is a global outsourcing solutions provider headquartered in Bengaluru, India. We are the preferred coding service provider for Fortune 500 companies and have been a preferred business partner for US-based service bureaus in litigation support services for over 20 years.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2004
- Employees: 600+
- Projects completed: 16,250+
- Pages processed: 1 billion+
- Documents handled: 250 million+
- Fields coded: 2 billion+
- Accuracy: 99.95%
- On-time delivery: 99.99%

## Services

### Legal Document Services
- Legal Coding & Document Management: Objective, subjective, and in-text coding. Logical Document Determination (LDD) / Unitization. Bates capture, redaction, stamping, and e-labeling. OCR and OCR clean-up. Hyperlinking and bookmarking. Document indexing and coding.
- Document Review: First-pass and second-pass review. Privilege review and logging. Relevancy and responsiveness review. Regulatory compliance review.
- Contracts Management: Contract abstraction and summarization. Repository management. Key term and clause extraction. Compliance tracking. Contract renewal management.
- Legal Research: Case law research and analysis. Regulatory compliance research. Due diligence support. Deposition summarization. Memoranda and brief preparation support.
- Electronic Data Discovery (EDD): EDD image quality control. Data processing and conversion. Image format conversion. Metadata extraction and validation. Load file preparation.
- Hybrid Coding: Technology-assisted review (TAR) support. Combined automated and manual coding workflows. Predictive coding validation.

### Business Process Services
- Forms Processing: CMS 1450 (UB-04) and CMS 1500 (HCFA) form processing. Data capture and validation.
- Insurance Processing: Claims document processing. Policy document management. Insurance form data entry.
- EFT Processing: Electronic funds transfer document processing. Transaction reconciliation. Audit trail maintenance.
- Accounts Payable: Invoice capture and data entry. Three-way matching. Exception handling.
- Image & Data Conversion: Format-to-format image conversion. Document digitization. Data migration and transformation.

### Specialized Services
- Transcription: Medical, legal, and general business transcription.
- Title Deed Processing & Mortgage: Title deed data extraction and indexing. Property record processing. Ownership verification and chain-of-title support. Mortgage origination document processing. Loan document indexing and validation. Closing document review and QC.
- Litigation Support: Trial exhibit preparation. Deposition summarization. Memoranda and brief support. Case chronology development.

## Certifications

- ISO 27001:2022 (BSI Certification): International standard for information security management systems.
- HIPAA Title II (Security Rules Compliance): US healthcare data protection requirements.
- SSAE18 Type-2 SOC 2 (Service Organization Control): Independent audit of security, availability, processing integrity, and confidentiality controls.
- PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry): Data security standard for organizations handling payment card information.
- ISAE 3402 (International Assurance Standard): International equivalent of SOC reports for global clients.

## Industries Served

- Oil & Energy: Regulatory compliance, environmental litigation, joint operating agreements, safety and incident reports.
- Financial Services: Contracts management, regulatory filings, compliance documentation, financial litigation.
- Insurance: Claims document processing and FNOL intake. Policy administration and issuance. Underwriting document support. Regulatory and compliance filings. Coverage spans P&C, life, health, and specialty carriers.
- Healthcare: Medical records coding, insurance claims processing (CMS 1450/1500), HIPAA-compliant document management.
- Telecom: Regulatory filing documentation, service agreement management, billing documentation.
- Automobile: Warranty documentation, regulatory compliance, product liability litigation, supply chain documentation.
- Airline: Regulatory compliance, safety records, operational procedures, maintenance records.
- Professional Sports: Transcript processing and classification, case processing and mail processing, document digitization and indexing, seasonal volume management. Processes 100,000+ transcripts annually for a leading US athletic association.
